Author: Nexai
Name: FCCH
Description: Free Company Chest Helper. Automate deposits, withdrawals, organization, crystals, workshop project pulls, and custom item lists.
Punchline: You ain't savin these slots, you puttin em to work.
Changelog:
New: Chest search bar with highlighted matches, modifier-click Fast Move to deposit/withdraw a single item, and a Merge action that consolidates stacks in place.
Rebuilt Sort to reorder items within the tab natively.
Crystals: right-click a cell to set its keep amount inline (no more popup).
